**Job Description:**
--------------------

At Intel, we are building the next generation of software technologies that unlock the potential of heterogeneous computing. Our compiler technologies help developers harness CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators through high-performance, portable software.

As an intern, you will contribute to an open ecosystem that advances performance, scalability, reliability, and developer productivity for AI, HPC, and other demanding workloads, while supporting Intel's commitment to contributing to and collaborating with open-source communities.

**About the Team**
------------------

The Intel Compiler Engineering Team develops LLVM-based C, C++, SYCL, Triton, MLIR, Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), and Fortran compiler technologies for Intel processor platforms, including CPUs and GPUs.

The team works across the compiler stack and in close collaboration with hardware architecture teams, covering language front ends, intermediate representations, optimization, code generation, debug information, runtimes, offload support, quality, and developer tooling. This work connects Intel hardware and compiler capabilities with AI frameworks and software ecosystems such as PyTorch, inference engines, and machine-learning models.

You will collaborate with experienced engineers and contribute to open-source communities while learning how production compilers are designed, tested, optimized, and delivered.

* Compiler features or MLIR-based intermediate representations

* Optimization, code generation, runtime, or offload support
* Debug information or testing infrastructure
* Performance analysis or developer tools

jobs.title: Intern - Mechatronics Engineer
jobs.description:
Human Computer Lab is a research lab building character robots that feel alive and responsive. Our first robot, LeLamp, explores a new category of consumer robotics where everyday objects become interactive and help us reshape our attachment to technology.

Our goal is to push the frontier of human-robot interaction by making technology more legible, emotionally intuitive, and human-centered. We are building the foundation for a new generation of robots designed for everyday environments.

We're looking for a mechatronics intern who can move fluidly between mechanical prototyping and controls work to support LeLamp's development. You'll build and iterate on prototyping rigs, take on lower-level controls and calibration work that currently competes for our engineers' time with deeper domain work, and support mechanical design tasks as needed. As the platform matures, this role will increasingly bridge mechanical and controls — running test-rig cycles, troubleshooting integration issues, and translating mechanical design changes into controls adjustments. This is a hands-on role for someone who'd rather be a generalist across the physical stack than specialize narrowly in one domain this early in their career.

**In this role, you will:**

* Build and iterate on prototyping rigs — mechanical assembly, wiring, and basic controls integration
* Take on lower-level controls tasks (sensor wiring, calibration, simple test scripts) that free up our controls and mechanical engineers for deeper domain work
* Support mechanical design tasks as needed — CAD iteration, fixture design, fit checks
* Bridge mechanical and controls as the product matures — run reliability/test-rig cycles, troubleshoot integration issues, and translate mechanical design changes into controls adjustments
* Explore mechanistic interpretability on the models behind LeLamp’s character and behavior, using techniques like probing and activation analysis to understand why the agent responds the way it does
* Help us spot and characterize behavior we didn’t design for, especially as people interact with LeLamp in unexpected ways
* Document test results and communicate issues clearly to the team

**You may be a good fit if you:**

* Are pursuing a degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
* Have some exposure to CAD (SolidWorks, Onshape, Fusion360, or similar) and basic controls/embedded work, from class projects, personal builds, or prior internships
* Have hands-on experience with rapid prototyping, machining, microcontrollers, or simple test rigs
* Have exposure to mechanistic interpretability or model-internals work (probing, activation patching, sparse autoencoders, or similar). This is a bonus, not a requirement.

* Are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and can create order through chaos
* Care about users and feel ownership over outcomes, even for systems you don't own
* Think holistically about systems and approach problems with creative, outside-the-box solutions

**You will be a strong fit, if you:**

* Are a jack-of-all-trades who's drawn to hands-on prototyping over deep specialization in one domain
* Move quickly and work well in rapid iteration cycles
* Are curious about what’s actually happening inside the models we ship, not just whether the outputs look right
* Take ownership over the systems you touch, even when they're not "yours"
* Work well in small, collaborative teams, without needing much day-to-day mentorship
* Are curious, resourceful, and motivated to solve difficult problems

The early team becomes the DNA of the company. We set ourselves and others to a high standard, and we respond with kindness when things get hard but keep everyone accountable. This requires us to be curious, creative, and diverse in our thinking and approach.
  
  
We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hold back unless they meet 100% of the criteria - we don’t want that to be the reason we miss out on great talent.

jobs.description:
**TYLin** is a globally recognized, full-service infrastructure consulting firm committed to providing innovative, cost-effective, constructible designs for the global infrastructure market. With over 3,000 employees throughout the Americas, Asia, and Europe, the firm provides support on projects of varying size and complexity. Together, we enhance conventional designs with smarter, more resilient systems. We provide people with better mobility. We steward precious resources by finding more sustainable solutions.

**Job Summary**
===============

We are seeking a motivated Civil Engineering Technology student to join our team as an intern. This position provides hands-on experience in municipal infrastructure projects involving watermain, sanitary sewer, storm sewer, roadworks, and land development projects. The successful candidate will assist engineering and technical staff with CAD drafting, design support, field investigations, construction activities, and project documentation.  
  
This role offers a balance of office-based design work and field exposure, allowing students to develop practical skills in civil engineering design, surveying, inspection, and infrastructure construction.

**Responsibilities & Qualifications**
=====================================

**Key Responsibilities**

**CAD and Design Support**

* Prepare and revise engineering drawings using AutoCAD Civil 3D and other design software.
* Assist with the development of plan and profile drawings for watermain, sanitary sewer, storm sewer, and roadway projects.
* Update existing drawings and infrastructure records based on field information and design changes.
* Support the preparation of engineering calculations, quantity estimates, and construction details.
* Assist in the preparation of tender and construction documentation.

**Field Work and Data Collection**

* Participate in site visits to collect field information and verify existing site conditions.
* Assist with infrastructure inspections, condition assessments, and construction monitoring.
* Support surveying and measurement activities under the direction of senior staff.
* Document field observations and prepare field reports.
* Monitor construction progress and verify compliance with project plans and specifications.

**Project Support**

* Organize project files, drawings, and technical documentation.
* Coordinate with engineers, technologists, contractors, and municipal staff as required.
* Assist with utility investigations and infrastructure inventory updates.
* Participate in project meetings and contribute to project discussions.
* Follow company health and safety policies and procedures during office and field activities.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Currently enrolled in a Civil Engineering Technology diploma program at an accredited college.
* Completion of at least one year of study.
* Basic knowledge of municipal infrastructure systems, including water distribution, sanitary sewer, and stormwater systems.
* Experience using AutoCAD; familiarity with Civil 3D is considered an asset.
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications.
* Valid driver's license and access to reliable transportation.
* Ability and willingness to complete training: Working at Heights, Confined Space, WHMIS, and Health & Safety in 4 Steps
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

**Preferred**

* Previous co-op, summer, or field experience in civil engineering or construction.
* Familiarity with surveying principles and equipment.
* Understanding of engineering drawings, plans, and specifications.
* Knowledge of municipal design standards and construction practices.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong organization and time-management skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Problem-solving and analytical abilities.
* Willingness to learn and take initiative.
* Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions.

**Learning Outcomes**

During this internship, the student will gain practical experience in:

* Civil infrastructure design and drafting.
* Municipal water, wastewater, and stormwater systems.
* AutoCAD Civil 3D applications.
* Engineering field investigations and construction inspection.
* Project coordination and documentation.
* Professional engineering and consulting practices.

TYLin is committed to pay equity. As part of that commitment, we have provided the base compensation range of $25.00-$27.00 hourly for this position and local market. We recognize that each candidate brings a unique set of skills, experience, education and competencies to the table that will be reflected in our offer. **Employment Type:** Temporary Full Time

**Workplace Type:** Hybrid

About our **Vancouver Office**

Located in the heart of downtown Vancouver, between the Pacific Ocean and the Coast Mountains, Teck’s Corporate Office sits in one of Canada’s most culturally diverse cities.

Surrounded by world-renowned nature and globally inspired cuisine, the office brings together many of Teck’s corporate functions - all working toward Teck’s purpose of providing the essential resources the world relies on.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

For this exciting position, we are specifically targeting students who are currently pursuing a degree in Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Mining, Industrial, or related Engineering discipline. Candidates must be enrolled in a Canadian post-secondary institution for the full duration of the co-op term and plan to return to their studies upon completion for at least one academic term. If you are not currently located near the work location, you must be willing to commute or temporarily relocate for the duration of the term. A valid study permit and studentship letter will be required where applicable.

We are seeking an engineering co-op student to support the Asset Integrity & Criticality (AIC) Team within the Central Asset Management group. In this role, you will support asset integrity, criticality, and lifecycle management initiatives across Teck's operations. This is an excellent opportunity to gain experience in asset management, reliability engineering, risk assessment, and data analytics while working with a diverse range of mining and infrastructure assets.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Be a courageous safety leader, adhere to and sponsor safety and environmental rules and procedures
* Support the development and maintenance of asset integrity, criticality, and lifecycle management documentation
* Assist with asset criticality assessments and risk evaluations across mobile, fixed, and infrastructure assets
* Collect, validate, and analyze asset performance, condition, and maintenance data from systems such as SAP, Maximo, and other data sources
* Conduct technical and economic analyses to support asset lifecycle and renewal planning decisions
* Assist in the development of asset health metrics, reporting tools, and performance dashboards using Power BI and Excel
* Support integrity management programs by compiling inspection results, condition assessment data, and integrity-related findings
* Contribute to asset replacement, rebuild, and life extension studies through data analysis and reporting
* Assist with enterprise document management activities, ensuring asset management standards, procedures, and governance documents remain current and accessible
* Participate in asset management reviews, technical meetings, and working sessions; capture meeting minutes, action items, and lessons learned as required
* Support Asset Integrity & Criticality Leads with ad hoc analyses, reporting requests, and special projects

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Pursuing a degree in Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Mining, Industrial, or related Engineering discipline
* Familiarity with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
* Interest in asset management, reliability engineering, risk assessment, or infrastructure management
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret technical and operational data
* Able to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
* Self-starter with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously
* Able to learn new systems, technologies, and analytical tools quickly and effectively
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and accuracy
* Experience with Power BI, Power Query, or data visualization tools would be considered an asset
* Experience with SAP, Maximo, or other enterprise asset management systems would be considered an asset

### ***Nous vous invitons à soumettre votre curriculum vitæ en français. Lorsqu'une version anglaise est disponible, vous pouvez également la joindre afin de faciliter les échanges avec certaines équipes de notre organisation internationale.*** ***We invite you to submit your résumé in French. When an English version is available, you may also include it to facilitate communication with certain teams within our international organization.***

  

**The Role**

This is a full-time co-op position based in Laval, Canada from **February to June** . Candidates must be available for the entire duration of the program.

The Quality Assurance Co-Op will support Quality operations and Quality Systems activities at Moderna’s cGMP manufacturing facility in Laval, Canada. The co-op provides practical exposure to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), controlled documentation, training administration, records management, and quality-system support within a regulated biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

Working with experienced Quality professionals and cross-functional partners, the co-op will help maintain accurate, organized, and inspection-ready Quality documentation while supporting routine compliance and continuous-improvement activities. The role is designed to provide meaningful exposure to Quality Assurance without independent Quality decision-making or ownership of Quality record closure.

**Here’s What You’ll Do**

* Support document control and records-management activities, including scanning, filing, archiving, retrieval, reconciliation, and organization of GMP records in accordance with approved procedures and retention requirements.
* Assist with training administration activities, including tracking assigned training, supporting training records and reports, and following up on routine training-compliance activities.
* Support preparation, formatting, routing, and administrative maintenance of controlled documents such as SOPs, work instructions, forms, and training materials under the direction of Quality personnel.
* Assist with periodic reviews of Quality documentation and trackers to help ensure records remain current, complete, accurate, and inspection ready.
* Support routine review and organization of electronic and paper GMP documentation for completeness and adherence to Good Documentation Practices; escalate observations to the responsible Quality team member.
* Help maintain Quality metrics, dashboards, trackers, action lists, and meeting materials used to monitor Quality-system and operational performance.
* Participate in Quality meetings and governance forums as appropriate, including capturing actions, maintaining trackers, and supporting follow-up activities.
* Support Quality and cross-functional teams with data gathering, document retrieval, and preparation of information for audits, inspections, self-inspections, and compliance walkthroughs.
* Identify and communicate potential documentation or process gaps to the responsible Quality team member and support implementation of approved improvements.
* Support continuous-improvement initiatives focused on documentation practices, records management, training administration, digital tools, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Quality, Manufacturing, Digital/IT, and other functions on assigned projects while maintaining GxP, data-integrity, confidentiality, and site-safety requirements.
* Complete all required training assignments in a timely manner and perform assigned activities in accordance with approved SOPs, work instructions, and safety requirements.
Contribute to special projects and other Quality Assurance activities as assigned.  

**Here’s What You’ll Need (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in a science, engineering, pharmacy, quality, life-sciences, or related discipline.
* Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Ability to work carefully with controlled records and follow written procedures in a regulated environment.
Ability to work on-site at the Moderna Laval facility for the duration of the co-op program.  

**Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Strong attention to detail, organization, and commitment to accurate documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in a collaborative team environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple assignments, meet timelines, and ask questions when clarification is needed.
* Interest in Quality Assurance, GMP manufacturing, Quality Systems, or the biopharmaceutical industry.
* Comfort working with data, trackers, electronic systems, and process-improvement activities.
* A proactive, curious, and collaborative mindset with a willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.
French and English communication skills are an asset for the Laval site.  

  

**Our Working Model**

As we build our company, we have always believed an in-person culture is critical to our success. Moderna champions the significant benefits of in-office collaboration by embracing a 70/30 work model. This 70% in-office structure helps to foster a culture rich in innovation, teamwork, and direct mentorship. Join us in shaping a world where every interaction is an opportunity to learn, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

Moderna is a smoke-free, alcohol-free, and drug-free work environment.

**Rémunération et avantages sociaux**

**Chez Moderna, nous croyons que lorsque vous vous sentez au mieux de votre forme, vous pouvez donner le meilleur de vous-même.**

C’est pourquoi nos avantages sociaux mondiaux et nos ressources en matière de bien-être sont conçus pour vous soutenir – au travail, à la maison et partout entre les deux.

* Des soins de santé de premier ordre, ainsi que des programmes d'avantages volontaires adaptés à vos besoins spécifiques
* Une approche holistique du bien-être, avec un accès à des se

jobs.title: Co-op, Project Coordinator (Kearl)
jobs.description:
Position Scope:

We are seeking a Co-op, Project Coordinator to support our North American Construction Group team in Fort McMurray. This is a great opportunity for an ambitious student looking to gain valuable experience in a dynamic and innovative company.

*(8-**12 month* *p**lacements are available, and preferred for this role. Willing to consider a 4 month term).*

Here at NACG, we are dedicated to being a part of your professional growth and pushing your future forward. Our people are what make North American Construction Group an industry leader, it’s our people that keep the largest fleet of equipment in Western Canada running and it's our people that keep our job sites safe.

**What’s In It for You?**

  

* Health and safety are our top priorities, with a commitment to 3-6-5.
* Competitive rate for the duration of the co-op term with scheduled wage increases.
* Valuable experience in the construction and mining industry.
* Opportunity to work with an experienced engineers and supportive team.
* Exposure to a variety of projects, tasks, and machinery.
* Networking opportunities and mentorship.
* Potential for future career growth within NACG.

**Where You Will Be Working**

**Location:** Fort McMurray

**Rate of Pay:** $24.00-$31.00

**Site:** Kearl

**Schedule:** 14x14-11.5hrs

**Accommodation:** Camp

**Tentative start date:** January 2027

Responsibilities:

**What You’ll Be Doing**

As a Co-op, Project Coordinator, you will:

* Work in a field office on-site, Fort McMurray.
* Collaborate with project managers, engineers, field supervisors, surveyors, maintenance personnel and equipment operators.
* Collect, interpret, and analyze operational data.
* Interact with staff and operational personnel.
* Report project details in a timely manner.
* Perform tasks based on your specific experience and skill sets.

Qualifications:

**What Makes You the ONE**

  

* Highly motivated individual with excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Pursuing a degree in Industrial, Civil, or Mining Engineering (other engineering disciplines considered).
* Valid Class 5 driver’s license (required).
* Ability to obtain CSO and Wildlife Awareness (including Bear Awareness) online certifications from Energy Safety Canada.

Summary:

**What’s Next**

After you submit your resume, our Recruitment team will review your application. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

If you're a dedicated and motivated student looking to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced construction and mining company, we encourage you to apply. We're confident that your contribution will be valued, and we look forward to being part of your educational and professional journey. Join North American Construction Group today and be a part of our shared success story!

Overview:

**What’s Next**

After you submit your resume, our Recruitment team will review your application. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

If you're a dedicated and motivated student looking to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced construction and mining company, we encourage you to apply. We're confident that your contribution will be valued, and we look forward to being part of your educational and professional journey. Join North American Construction Group today and be a part of our shared success story!

**Who Is NACG?**

North American Construction Group (NACG) has served as an industry leader in the heavy construction and mining industries for over 65 years. In that time, we’ve proven ourselves as a safe and reliable contractor who can complete projects of any size and scope. We’ve also taken several bold steps forward to broaden our footprint, expanding to mines outside our provincial borders, and providing third-party maintenance services to clients and customers.

North American Construction Group is committed to providing a diverse and inclusive work environment where every employee feels safe, valued, and respected. We recognize the talent, perspective, and creative influence that diverse groups of people generate, and we encourage all people to express interest with us especially those from marginalized and underrepresented groups who might hesitate before applying. If you require accommodation in submitting interest on a role or throughout our interview process, please email us at careers@nacg.ca to ask for assistance.

**North American Construction Group acknowledges that we perform work on the Traditional Treaty 6 and 8 Territories, home to the Cree, Dene, Blackfoot, Saulteaux and Nakota Sioux, and the Metis. We encourage members of those and all traditional lands to apply with us.**

**Become a member of the North American family today!**

jobs.title: Student Intern - Track Installation
jobs.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a motivated co-op student to support track construction activities on railway, transit, or heavy civil infrastructure projects. This role provides hands-on experience in field inspections, construction documentation, quality control, coordination, and project closeout while working alongside experienced construction professionals.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Support track construction activities, including ballast, rail, special trackwork, and embedded track installation.
* Assist with field inspections and document track construction progress.
* Compile and maintain construction records, red-line markups, turnover documentation, and quality records.
* Assist with Construction Turnover Packages and project closeout documentation.
* Coordinate track construction activities with other project disciplines.
* Monitor construction progress and identify schedule impacts.
* Participate in quality inspections and corrective actions.
* Review drawings, specifications, and design packages.
* Assist with quantity tracking, material inventories, and reporting.
* Support safety audits and inspections.
* Track the procurement and delivery of track materials.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
  

  

**Required Knowledge and Experience**
-------------------------------------

* Currently enrolled in a Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or related co-op program.
* Interest in railway, transit, or heavy civil infrastructure construction.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills.
* Experience with Bluebeam, Aconex, AutoCAD, or Primavera P6 is considered an asset.
* Valid Class 5 driver’s licence; Graduated Driver Licensing (GDL) is acceptable.
* Bilingual proficiency in French and English is considered an asset.

We work in collaborative teams, both within the company and with our partners and customers, to plan, design, build, and modernize infrastructure. We take special pride in projects and solutions that improve communities as well as people’s quality of life by promoting economic growth, enhancing mobility, and increasing sustainability and resiliency. Powered by our people, we provide the imagination necessary to support our customers’ visions—and to help them see what's next!This job posting is for a current addition or replacement opportunity within Parsons.We value our employees and want our employees to take care of their overall wellbeing, which is why we offer best-in-class benefits such as health, vision, dental, employer paid provincial care premiums, Defined Contribution Pension Plan (DCPP), Tax-Free Savings Account (TFSA), Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP), life insurance, paid time off, sick leave, all province observed holidays off, and gym membership discounts to fit your busy lifestyle!Parsons is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility in the workplace. Parsons equally employs representation at all job levels for indigenous peoples, women, individuals with disabilities, and visible minorities.We truly invest and care about our employee’s wellbeing and provide endless growth opportunities as the sky is the limit, so aim for the stars! Parsons is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices. To learn more about recruitment fraud and how to report it, please refer to https://www.parsons.com/fraudulent-recruitment/.

We care about your financial wellbeing. Parsons offers competitive pay and retirement plans to help you build wealth for the future while giving you the flexibility to diversify your investments.

Balance in life is important and time away from the office is imperative to allow you to refresh and focus your attention on the things that matter to you. Parsons supports your time away by providing paid time off and paid flexible holidays.

We are committed to fostering the personal and professional growth of our employees. Develop and advance yourself though our comprehensive training, educational and mentorship programs.

We provide Industry leading benefits to support veterans and active-duty members to provide security for you and your family by offering robust leave and benefits; including paid active-duty military leave and paid time off when transitioning back to civilian life.

At Parsons we inspire healthier habits, heathier minds, and a healthier you through our wellness program. Participate in our weekly Meditation Mondays and Wellness Wednesdays. Wellness, at Parsons, is more than just your annual checkup.

Health is not a one size fits all. At Parsons, we offer a robust Employee Assistance Program as well as comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans through large, national carriers with the choice of regional PPO, HDHP, or HMO networks.

jobs.title: Student Project Coordinator- Buildings West
jobs.description:
Student Project Coordinator- Buildings WestOur internships and Co-ops are designed to provide you with a business relevant project that will allow you to independently manage your own area of responsibility, while receiving support from an assigned Supervisor and Technical Mentor. We’ll help you discover your strengths and development areas in a challenging, fun, and supportive work environment.
  
  
Projects are scoped in alignment with your term length, and typically focus on a current construction project.
  
  
We are seeking a student to join us for an 8 month co-op position starting in January 2027. This position will be based out of Richmond, BC.

**What You Will Be Working On**
===============================

Project Coordination:

* Coordinate drawings and work specific scope/trades.
* Review trade quotes, verify material quantities, hours, and rates.
* Participate in project meetings.
* Conduct deficiency walks and update deficiency logs.
* Issue warranties.
* Take and coordinate progress photos.
* Update field drawings and produce as-built drawings.

Field Coordination:

* Perform quantity takeoffs.
* Coordinate sub-trade work.
* Verify site conditions and coordinate with drawings.
* Supervise sub-trade work.
* Set up and maintain record keeping.
* Layout site lines and grades using total station.

Scheduling:

* Update project schedules.
* Create manual schedules and update schedules
* Obtain scheduling information from sub-trades.
* Create and maintain graphical scheduling
* Monitor manpower productivity.

This job description outlines the general nature and level of work performed by the Student Project Coordinator. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required for the role, and it may vary depending on assignment. Bird may modify or add to the job duties and qualifications as needed.

**Who We Need On Our Team**

  

* You are currently enrolled in Civil, Mechanical, Structural Engineering, or Construction program
* You will complete at least one more semester of education following your internship and possess a GPA of 3.0 or higher
* Ability to lead and operate within an environment where change happens frequently
* Ability to forge, grow and maintain positive relationships
* Exemplify the Ideal Team Player – Hungry, Humble, Smart
* Highly developed interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills
* Sense of urgency and strong commitment to achieving goals
* Ability to work collaboratively with a positive attitude
* Residency, or a valid work permit which would allow you to work for Bird Construction or one of our wholly owned subsidiaries
* If you are selected for a role with client specific requirements, you may be required to successfully complete a pre-employment Medical and/or Alcohol & Drug testing.
* All applications must include a current transcript

The pay range for this role is $23-$27 per hour.

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

**For Those Who Seek to Redefine**
==================================

The greatest achievements in history are borne from the greatness within people – where human potential meets vision, and passion fuels evolution. Unlocking this potential is the most important thing we do at Bird.

As a leader in Canadian construction for over 100 years, the impact of our team is etched deeply within the core of our legacy. Beyond Bird, this impact is felt in the fundamental aspects of our everyday lives. From the critical infrastructure we depend on, to the energy and resources that keep us moving - we are powering our communities and shaping Canada’s skylines coast-to-coast-to-coast. Entrenched in the foundation of a culture built more than a century ago is an enduring quest to reimagine what is possible. Our impact is greater than ever, and we are looking for those who seek to redefine their story.

**What We Believe In**
======================

**We Put Safety First**
-----------------------

A healthy and safe work environment is non-negotiable. We build a culture of operational and psychological safety through engagement, learning and leadership.

**We Lead With Honesty**
------------------------

We speak and act with integrity, clarity and care so people can trust our word and our work. Being honest means we can deliver the best outcomes and consistent results.

**We Are Stronger Together**
----------------------------

Success is a team effort. Our inclusive workplace enables our combined expertise, humility and creativity to unlock our greater potential.

**We Are Driven To Do Great Work**
----------------------------------

We built our name on quality. We have a passion for excellence in our work and relationships that honours our businesses and our industry.

**We Create Opportunity**
-------------------------

Rooted in a solid foundation, we adapt and grow to face the future. We are committed to elevating each other to chart the best path forward in an evolving world.

At Bird, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DE&I) and believe it is essential to our success. We will continue to listen, learn, and take action in our commitment to building progress in our organization, and the industry as a whole. Cultivating an environment where all employees feel included, seen, and have a sense of belonging is core to Bird’s culture. We commit to proactively employing a workforce that reflects the communities in which we work, fostering an environment of continuous learning, and never compromising on our values.

jobs.title: Software Developer Intern
jobs.description:
**Your TAIT Internship**
========================

At TAIT, interns do more than observe - they contribute. Our immersive internship program connects your interests and area of study with meaningful, hands-on work alongside teams that push the boundaries of what is possible.

You will help bring real projects to life, learn from industry experts, and build skills that move your career forward. We provide mentorship and support while empowering you to set goals, take initiative, and shape your experience.

Ready to challenge yourself, share new ideas, and make an impact? Your journey starts here.

**What You Need to Know**
=========================

* Location: Montreal, QC
* Duration: May 17, 2027 - August 13, 2027
* Compensation: $29.00 CAD per hour
* Schedule: 40 hours per week on first shift, based on project and business needs
* Eligibility: Applicants must meet the work authorization requirements for the country where the role is based

**Your Role at TAIT**
=====================

As a Software Development Intern, you will work alongside experienced developers to learn how a software team designs, builds, tests, and maintains its products. You will contribute to clearly defined tasks matched to your experience, with opportunities to take on more complex work as your skills and confidence grow.

**What You Will Work On**
=========================

* Complete clearly defined development tasks, such as straightforward features, bug fixes, tests, and documentation improvements.
* Write clear, maintainable code using established team standards and practices.
* Build familiarity with the team's technologies, tools, codebase, and development workflow.
* Assist with testing and troubleshooting by identifying, investigating, and communicating software issues.
* Participate in code reviews, pairing sessions, and team discussions, applying feedback to improve your work.
* Document assigned work, communicate progress and challenges, and ask questions when support is needed.
* Work with your mentor to set learning goals and reflect on your progress throughout the internship.

**What You Bring**
==================

To qualify for this internship, you should have:

* Current enrollment in a degree, DEC, DEP, or other relevant program in Computer Science, Software Development, or a related discipline, or equivalent foundational learning.
* An expected graduation date between December 2026 and May 2028.
* A GPA of 3.0 or above, or equivalent academic standing where applicable.
* A basic understanding of programming concepts, including variables, control flow, functions, and data structures.
* Interest in learning development tools and practices such as version control, testing, and code review.
* A thoughtful approach to problem-solving, attention to detail, and willingness to work through unfamiliar tasks with support.
* Clear communication skills, a collaborative mindset, curiosity, and openness to feedback.

**Where This Could Take You**
=============================

* Software Developer or Software Engineer
* Quality Assurance or Test Automation Engineer
* DevOps or Platform Engineer

**Why Intern at TAIT**
======================

* Meaningful Work: Contribute to projects that matter, including experiences seen by millions of people.
* Professional Growth: Gain practical experience and develop skills that support your future career.
* Mentorship: Learn from experienced professionals who provide guidance, feedback, and support.
* Innovation: Collaborate with creative teams developing forward-thinking solutions.
* Connections: Build relationships with industry leaders, experienced colleagues, and fellow interns.
* Future Opportunities: Successful interns may be considered for full-time or part-time roles.

Bring your ideas to life, grow your skills, and help us create moments that move people. Apply today and start your journey with TAIT.

jobs.title: Software Development Coop
jobs.description:
Vancouver · Hourly · Entry-level

#### **About The Position**

**Software Development Co-op– Summer 2026**

  
  

**A Career at Clarius**

Today, as many as 25 million medical professionals globally don’t have access to medical imaging, which is proven to improve patient care and reduce healthcare costs. That’s why we’re on a mission to make medical imaging accessible everywhere by delivering high-performance, affordable, and easy-to-use solutions powered by artificial intelligence and connected to the cloud.

  
  

By making Clarius your next career move, you’re joining a team of 140+ people who are talented, innovative, and highly collaborative. You’re also joining a community that includes thousands of physicians worldwide who use Clarius to deliver better patient care – over two million high-definition exams have been performed using Clarius! And you’re joining a thrice-certified Great Place to Work!

  
  
  

**Your Role**

Located in Vancouver, BC, Clarius designs high-performance handheld ultrasound systems that make medical imaging more accessible and affordable through AI-powered solutions.

We are seeking innovative, dedicated people to join our Cloud team for a co-op project and gain hands-on experience developing scalable, customer-focused software solutions.

This cloud-focused project includes front-end and back-end development, REST API enhancements, and modernization of cloud-based UI components. You will work within a complex full-stack codebase and gain hands-on experience applying test-driven development practices.

  

**Core Responsibilities**

* Improve accessibility and mobile layouts
* Adhere to test‑driven development (TDD) practices
* Assist senior developers on larger and more difficult projects
* Build UIs with Vue, Tailwind and PrimeVue
  

  

**Education, Experience & Skills**

* Currently pursuing a degree in Software Development or a similar degree.
* Full-Stack Web Development with Python or JavaScript
* Familiarity with REST APIs
* Experience with frameworks such as Django, Vue, or similar
* Attention to detail
* Independent and self-motivated
* Ability to understand complex software architectures
* Exposure to C++ and QT is considered an asset
* A design portfolio (Figma or similar) is considered a bonus
* Interest in healthcare or medical imaging
  

  
  

**Location and Compensation:**

This is a hybrid position, so candidates must be within commuting distance of our headquarters in Vancouver, BC.

  
  

This is a temporary full time role at 40 hours per week for a minimum of 8 months.

  
  

The hourly rate for this role is $22 to $25 CAD.

  
  
  

**More Reasons to Consider:**

**Workspace:** Our modern office features sit/stand desks, various health & wellness facilities, a stocked kitchen, outdoor amenities, on-site daycare, enclosed parking, a free on-site gym and close proximity to a SkyTrain station.

  
  

**Learning, Growth, and Career Development:** Work alongside experienced professionals to receive mentorship and guidance, enhancing your knowledge and skills in software and cloud-based solutions.

  
  

**Impactful Work**: Contribute to meaningful projects that improve access to healthcare, making a difference in people’s lives while developing your professional abilities.

  
  

*Clarius Mobile Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage applications from any qualified candidate regardless of ethnicity, religion, age, national origin, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. Please let us know if you require any accommodations during the interview process.*

  

#### **Requirements**

* **Required**
* Currently enrolled in a co-op programme in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field
* Full-stack web development with Python and JavaScript
* Experience with Django and Vue
* Familiarity with REST APIs
* Strong attention to detail and able to work independently in a complex codebase

**Assets**

* Previous web development co-op or internship
* Unit testing experience
* A design portfolio (Figma or similar)
* Exposure to C++ or Qt
* Interest in healthcare or medical imaging

jobs.title: Software Developer - Common Cloud Services (Co-Op)
jobs.description:
**SUMMARY**

We are recruiting an intern to join our software development team working on common micro-services that will integrate into a wide array of Ribbon cloud-native products. The micro-service development approach provides many advantages by reducing complexity and dependencies during development and deployment. We are developing tools that leverage the latest container, virtualization, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and cloud computing concepts.

If the pandemic prevents going into our offices, the internship can be performed remotely. Otherwise, the site is open everyday, with most of team works from the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays.  
  
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

You’ll use modern AI coding tools to understand existing code, investigate problems, implement changes, troubleshoot failures, generate and improve tests, and analyze results.

Just as importantly, you’ll learn how to **question and validate AI-generated work** using tests, measurements, code review, and engineering judgment.

**What You’ll Work On**

Depending on project priorities, your work could include:

* Improving **parity and behavioral testing** that compares expected behavior across implementations.
* Testing how network management pipeline components work together, from incoming data through processing to stored or displayed results.
* Developing **end-to-end test scenarios** for realistic user, network, or device workflows.
* Measuring **performance and scale** and comparing results across configurations or implementations.
* Improving the tools and automation engineers use to **build, test, troubleshoot, and validate** software changes.
* Using AI to understand unfamiliar areas of the codebase, investigate defects, analyze logs and test failures, and propose potential solutions.
* Participating in code reviews, debugging sessions, and technical discussions with experienced networking software engineers.

**Working in an AI-Driven Engineering Process**

This internship is about more than using AI to generate code.

You’ll learn how experienced developers integrate AI into their engineering workflow:

**Senior developer defines the problem and constraints Intern works with AI AI assists with analysis and implementation Tests and measurements validate the result Intern reviews the output Senior developer provides technical guidance**

You’ll learn how to provide AI with the right technical context, recognize when its suggestions are incomplete or incorrect, and use objective evidence to determine whether a change actually works.

The goal is to develop both **AI fluency and strong engineering judgment**.

**Mentorship**

You’ll work closely with a senior developer who will help:

* Define and scope your project.
* Explain relevant system behavior and architecture.
* Help you navigate an existing codebase.
* Guide your use of AI development tools.
* Review your code, tests, and technical conclusions.
* Help you understand the engineering trade-offs behind different approaches.

You won’t be expected to make product or architecture decisions independently. Instead, you’ll get first-hand experience seeing **how experienced engineers approach complex problems and how AI can augment that process**.

**What We’re Looking For**

You may be a good fit if you:

* Are pursuing a degree in **Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering**, or a related technical field.
* Have experience programming and debugging software.
* Understand basic software development concepts such as testing, version control, and code review.
* Have an interest in **networking, systems software, or distributed systems**.
* Are curious about Generative AI, LLMs, and AI-assisted software engineering.
* Enjoy investigating problems and understanding *why* something works or fails.
* Can communicate technical reasoning and findings clearly.
* Are comfortable **questioning and verifying AI-generated suggestions rather than simply accepting them**.

Experience with **Rust, Linux, Git, networking, automated testing, containers, or AI coding tools** is helpful, but not required.

**What You’ll Learn**

During the internship, you’ll gain hands-on experience with:

* AI-assisted software engineering.
* Working directly with senior software developers.
* Understanding and modifying a production-scale codebase.
* Network management and systems software.
* Automated and end-to-end testing.
* Performance and scale analysis.
* Debugging and root-cause investigation.
* Using tests and measurements to validate AI-generated software changes.
* Professional code review and engineering practices.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful internship will deliver a **useful, tested engineering improvement** along with a clear explanation of:

* What problem was addressed.
* What changed.
* How AI was used.
* How the result was tested and validated.
* What was learned.
* What limitations or follow-up work remain.

The objective is not simply to generate more code with AI. It is to learn how to use AI **effectively and responsibly within a disciplined software engineering process**, while developing the technical judgment needed to produce softwar

**Steel is building open-source browser infrastructure for AI agents and apps**. We make it easy for developers to ship AI products that interact with the web using our Sessions API.

We are seeking a tech-savvy and curious **Full-Stack Developer (Student / Co-op)** to join our software team. In this role, you will work across a variety of business tools, internal systems, and cloud-based applications supporting our engineers, data scientists, and business operations.

Our team operates with high autonomy and embraces cutting-edge development paradigms, including heavy use of **agentic engineering** to develop a mixture of traditional software and agent-enabled software systems. If you thrive on taking ideas from conception to deployment and want to gain hands-on experience with modern cloud architectures, this role is for you.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **End-to-End Ownership:** Take features and business tools from initial conception through prototyping, testing, and cloud deployment.
* **Hybrid Systems Development:** Build, test, and maintain both traditional software microservices and agent-enabled software workflows.
* **Business & Internal Tooling:** Develop, enhance, and maintain a variety of web applications and internal tools designed to streamline engineering, manufacturing, and business functions.
* **Rapid Prototyping:** Collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team to build and test new features quickly based on user and business feedback.
* **Code & Documentation Quality:** Write modular, reusable code and maintain clear documentation for system implementations and processes.

### **Technical & Design Stack**

**Core Languages & Frameworks**

* **Languages:** Python, Golang, and TypeScript.
* **Front-End:** Vue.js for building responsive and intuitive user interfaces.

**Architecture & Infrastructure**

* **Cloud & Hosting:** Serverless architectures and containerized environments (**Docker**).
* **Database & Cloud:** Basic understanding of SQL, NoSQL, or cloud-managed databases (e.g., AWS, GCP).
* **DevOps & Version Control:** Familiarity with Git version control and modern CI/CD practices.

**Engineering Methodologies**

* **Agentic Engineering:** Exposure to or interest in leveraging AI agents, automated tool workflows, and LLM integration within application architecture.

**Design & Prototyping**

* Familiarity with basic UI/UX design principles to build user-friendly interfaces.
* Experience or interest in using prototyping and design/internal tool builders (e.g., Figma, Draw.io, Retool).

### **What We Look For**

We understand that student applicants may not have extensive experience in every single language or framework listed above. Above all, we value:

* **Adaptability & Curiosity:** A strong appetite for learning new languages (Golang, Python, TypeScript) and modern software paradigms quickly.
* **Problem-Solving Ability:** The capacity to tackle ambiguous problems with high autonomy and deliver practical solutions.
* **Collaborative Mindset:** A desire to work closely with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders to build meaningful tools.

If you find this role exciting and are eager to contribute to sustainable tech, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Chemical Engineering Co-op Student
jobs.description:
**WELCOME TO VCNA!**

  

We are St Marys Cement, part of Votorantim Cimentos North America (VCNA).

  

As the North American operations of Votorantim Cimentos, a global building materials and sustainability solutions leader in 11 countries, we are helping to make a positive impact and are transforming our world. We have a culture built on solid partnerships, long-lasting relationships, and opportunities for those who want to learn, grow and be part of a diverse and dynamic culture.

  

With solutions that include cement, ready-mix concrete, and aggregates, we help to build homes, highways, hospitals, buildings, bridges, and schools across the Canadian and U.S. Great Lakes region and Northeast United States. Our commitment to excellence can be seen in those who invest and believe in what we do, those who share their lives with us, those who trust in our deliveries and those committed to innovation and a sustainable future.

  

Every day, we have the chance to accomplish something new and you're invited to be part of it.

  

**Summary/Job Scope:**

We are seeking a motivated and analytical **Chemical Engineering Co-op Student** to join our team for an upcoming work term at our Bowmanville Cement Plant. This role offers hands-on experience within the Laboratory, Production, and Process Engineering departments, providing exposure to cement manufacturing operations, quality control systems, process optimization, environmental performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  

The successful candidate will work alongside experienced engineers, laboratory professionals, and production leaders while contributing to projects that improve product quality, operational efficiency, sustainability, and safety.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Assist with laboratory testing and analysis of raw materials, clinker, cement, fuels, and other process materials.
* Support quality assurance and quality control activities, including sample collection, preparation, testing, and reporting.
* Analyze production and process performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and process improvement initiatives.
* Support kiln, finish mill, quarry, and material handling process optimization projects.
* Assist in the monitoring and evaluation of key production and quality metrics.
* Participate in root cause investigations related to process upsets, quality deviations, or operational challenges.
* Assist with environmental compliance monitoring and sustainability-related initiatives.
* Prepare technical reports, presentations, and process documentation.
* Support continuous improvement projects focused on safety, reliability, productivity, energy efficiency, and emissions reduction.
* Collaborate with laboratory, maintenance, operations, reliability, and environmental teams on cross-functional projects.
* Conduct research and benchmarking activities to support engineering recommendations.
* Maintain accurate records of testing results, project findings, and process observations.
* Ensure the safety of themselves and all colleagues by following safe work practices and promoting a strong safety culture.
  

**Note:** This job description may not cover all duties and requirements and may include additional tasks as assigned by the supervisor.

  

**Qualifications:**

* Enrolled in a Chemical Engineering undergraduate program at a recognized Canadian institution.
* Completion of 1-2 years of study preferred.
* Strong understanding of chemical engineering principles, industrial processes, and data analysis.
* Interest in manufacturing, process engineering, quality systems, or industrial operations.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
* Experience with statistical analysis, process simulation, or data visualization software is considered an asset.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced industrial environment.
* Demonstrated commitment to health, safety, and environmental stewardship.
  

**Note**: This role is temporary for a maximum period of up to 1 year, with requirement where student must work at least 35 hours for a minimum of 12 weeks. The position is based out of Bowmanville, Ontario.

  

***Please note that the Bowmanville site is not easily accessible via public transit. Student will need to ensure transport to and from the plant in line with agreed schedule.***

  

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?**

Being part of VCNA is being part of building famous landmarks such as Toronto's CN Tower, Roy Thompson Hall, Maple Leaf Gardens and the Darlington Nuclear Station and Ryerson Centre, St. Regis Chicago and 150 N. Riverside, Louis High-Speed Rail in Chicago and more

* Opportunities to collaborate with teams around the globe and growth opportunities in different areas
* Training, professional development
* Access to Employees Resource Groups (ERGs), including SheBuilds, which fosters mentorship, leadership development and community support
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP): confidential support for you and your family (CAN)
* Flexible work environment with options for remote work
  

**Hourly Rate**: $25 per hour.

  

**OUR PEOPLE**

We care about people - all people. At VCNA, we take safety, health and wellness seriously. We're dedicated to giving our employees a safe workplace, our neighbors a safe environment and our customers a high-quality and safe product. Safety first -and always!

  

Our VC Way reflects who we are, inspiring us to unite our culture and be our best: Our Way of Being: ethical and respectful, Our Way of Working: together with excellence and Our Way of Thriving: with the courage to transform.

  

**INCLUSION AND EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYMENT**

We have a results-oriented culture that values being open, honest, and authentic. It's part of our DNA. We are continually expanding our diverse and inclusive team by providing opportunities for everyone,

We're looking for a motivated Quality & Inventory Co-op to join our Quality team. This is an excellent opportunity for students interested in quality systems, manufacturing, inventory management, and process improvement.

You'll support quality inspections, inventory accuracy, ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS) implementation, internal audits, and process documentation while collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement across the organization.

**What You'll Do**

* Perform incoming inspections of purchased materials and components.
* Record inspection results and maintain quality records.
* Identify and document non-conforming materials and products.
* Prepare Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs).
* Update quality information in ERP and quality management systems where applicable.
* Assist with supplier quality activities.
* Support the implementation and maintenance of the ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS).
* Assist in drafting policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and process flow charts.
* Work with cross-functional teams to document end-to-end business processes.
* Coordinate document revisions and version control.
* Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for standardization.
* Track action items and project milestones related to ISO implementation.
* Coordinate employee training related to new or revised Standard Operating Procedures.
* Support onboarding documentation and process training.
* Promote awareness of quality standards and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
* Assist in planning and coordinating internal quality audits.
* Track audit findings and corrective actions.
* Monitor completion of corrective and preventive actions.
* Perform cycle counts, investigate inventory discrepancies, identify root causes, and process inventory adjustments.
* Assist with warehouse organization, storage optimization, location labeling, and Vertical Lift Module (VLM) organization.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Purchasing, Inventory, Production, Shipping & Receiving, Service, Finance, and other departments to support quality and inventory initiatives.

**What We're Looking For**

* Currently enrolled in a college or university program in Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Ability to read engineering drawings.
* Knowledge of measuring tools (calipers, micrometers, gauges) is considered an asset.
* Strong process mapping skills (Visio or similar).
* Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Knowledge of ERP systems and ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems is considered an asset.
* Knowledge of manufacturing, inventory management, or continuous improvement principles is an asset.
* Strong communication and teamwork abilities.

**Why Join PSI Engineering?**

* Gain hands-on experience with quality management systems, inventory management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Work alongside experienced professionals who are invested in your learning and development.
* Contribute to meaningful projects that support ISO 9001 implementation and operational excellence.
* Develop practical skills in quality assurance, inventory control, process mapping, internal auditing, and ERP systems.
* Collaborative and supportive team environment.
* Opportunity to build industry experience and expand your professional network.

**PSI Engineering is proud to support student learning through co-op opportunities. This position is intended to be supported through the Student Work Placement Program (SWPP). To meet program eligibility requirements, applicants must be Canadian citizens, permanent residents, or persons granted refugee protection under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act, be legally entitled to work in Canada, and be enrolled at a Canadian post-secondary institution. Please ensure you meet these requirements before applying.**

PSI Engineering is committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process upon request.

  

We thank all applicants; however, only those selected for interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: DSP & Systems Architecture Intern
jobs.description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

This is an existing vacancy.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

Our team is focused on Advanced Technologies within Central Engineering organization, providing the most advanced and key IPs to all businesses within Marvell. Our team makes an outsized impact not only for the organization but also to the technological arc of innovation for future generations of Marvell's high-speed wireline and optical products.

**What You Can Expect**

As our DSP & Systems Intern, you will work on systems-level problems that sit at the boundary of research and production — where the algorithms and architectures you develop have direct consequences for how AI infrastructure performs at scale. Specifically, you can expect to:

* Architect, model, and evaluate system-level designs for electrical/optical interconnects — developing analytical models and simulations that inform real silicon architecture decisions
* Develop and optimize DSP algorithms for high-speed electrical or optical links, including equalization adaptation, calibration, timing recovery, and signal integrity techniques for both electrical and optical links
* Collaborate with analog, digital, photonics, and firmware engineering teams to validate architectural assumptions against real hardware and silicon measurements
* Build behavioral models and simulations in MATLAB or Python to evaluate performance tradeoffs
* Present architectural proposals and algorithm results to engineering leadership and contribute to internal technical documentation and design reviews

**What We're Looking For**

* Currently enrolled in a Ph.D. Or M.Sc. program in Electrical Engineering or a related field, with research focused on optical/electrical interconnects, digital signal processing, or communication systems.
* Strong foundation in signal processing, communication theory, control systems, optimization, or system architecture, with the ability to apply theoretical concepts to practical engineering problems.
* Research or project experience in one or more of the following areas: high-speed communications, DSP algorithm development, optical communications, SerDes systems, signal integrity, equalization, clock and data recovery, or system-level architecture.
* Experience developing models and simulations using MATLAB, Python, C/C++, or similar tools to evaluate complex system behavior and performance tradeoffs.
* Self-motivated, curious, and able to work effectively in a collaborative environment spanning DSP, analog, digital, photonics, firmware, and systems engineering disciplines.

**Expected Base Pay Range (CAD)**

45 - 61, $ per hour.

**Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements**

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

**Interview Integrity**

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

**This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.**

jobs.title: Growth Intern (Winter 2027)
jobs.description:
**About Steel**
---------------

**Steel is building open-source browser infrastructure for AI agents and apps**. We make it easy for developers to ship AI products that interact with the web using our Sessions API.

With over 7,000 GitHub stars, dozens of paying customers, and millions of sessions served monthly, we grew our platform 50x in 2025 purely through word-of-mouth and our open-source community. Backed by world-class investors, we're building a small, highly motivated, and talent-dense team that's shaping the future of how humans interact with the internet.

More on the problems we're solving: https://docs.steel.dev/overview/intro-to-steel

**The Role**
------------

We're looking for a creative, chronically online Growth Intern to help make Steel impossible to ignore.
  
  
You'll work closely with our team to create content, experiment with new ideas, and find creative ways to get Steel in front of developers building the next generation of AI agents.  
You'll help shape how Steel shows up online, bringing together content, design, and creative experimentation to build a brand that resonates with developers. We're looking for someone with good taste, a pulse on internet culture, and the ability to turn ideas into things people actually want to see and share.

**Sample projects include...**
------------------------------

* Creating social content that gets people talking about Steel
* Shooting and editing short-form videos, product demos, and behind-the-scenes content
* Designing graphics, social assets, and other creative materials in Figma
* Experimenting with trends, formats, and unconventional ways to reach developer audiences
* Helping launch new features, open-source projects, and creative campaigns
* Working with engineers to uncover interesting stories, identify compelling angles, and turn technical work into content developers want to share
* Bringing creative ideas to life, from concept to execution

**Requirements**
----------------

* Chronically online. You understand internet culture, emerging trends, and what makes content resonate
* Have good taste and strong creative instincts, whether in design, writing, video, or something else entirely
* Comfortable creating things, experimenting with different formats, and learning new tools
* Strong communication skills and the ability to turn technical ideas into compelling, accessible content
* Resourceful, self-directed, and willing to figure things out as you go
* Genuinely interested in AI and developer tools. You keep up with what people are building and have opinions about what's exciting and why
* Able to work in person from our Toronto office

**Nice-to-haves**
-----------------

* Have built something with AI, whether it's a side project, app, automation, or experiment. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should understand what excites developers.
* Experience with Figma, video editing, photography, or motion graphics
* Have grown a social media account, created content, or built an online community
* Have a portfolio of creative projects, even if they're just things you've made for fun
* Familiarity with developer communities on X, Reddit, Hacker News, or Discord
* Experience organizing events, running campaigns, or working on a startup or side project

**Applying**
------------

We care more about your creativity, taste, and initiative than a traditional résumé. Your application has two parts:

**1. Your work.** Share a link to something you’ve made. It could be a video, a design, a social account, or a side project.

**2. A short video (5 minutes max).** Pick one thing you made that you’re proud of and walk us through it: what it is, why you made it, and what you’d do differently. No fancy editing needed. Share it as a link we can open without requesting access (Loom, unlisted YouTube, or a Drive link set to “anyone with the link”).

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule an interview and discuss your work and ideas.

jobs.description:
**About EETS**  
Eco Eolic Top System Inc. (EETS) is a Mississauga-based cleantech startup developing patented aerodynamic retrofit components for heavy-duty trucks, trailers and cargo containers. Our products reduce drag, fuel use and GHG emissions across freight fleets.

**The opportunity**  
16-week paid internship · $19.70/hour · 35 hours/week  
Start: January 2027 · Apply by December 1, 2026

**Work model**  
Primarily remote; you can live anywhere in Ontario or Quebec. On-site activities (prototyping, supplier visits, pilot installations) take place in the Greater Toronto Area, and you must be able to attend in person when required. Any travel for company work outside the GTA is covered by EETS.

**What you’ll do**

* Build and update 3D CAD models and technical drawings of aerodynamic components
* Run and interpret CFD simulations to evaluate airflow and drag
* Help design and build prototypes in plastics, thermoplastics and composites
* Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturing shops
* Support occasional on-site pilot installations on trucks and trailers, collect field data and troubleshoot
* Write clear reports on installations, test results and design improvements

**What you’ll gain**  
Hands-on experience taking a product from CAD and CFD to real trucks on the road, with direct mentorship from our Engineering Director. You’ll receive training in CFD, prototyping, safe fieldwork and performance analysis.

**What we’re looking for**

* Canadian citizen or permanent resident
* Current student in a mechanical, aerospace, automotive or related engineering degree or technical diploma at a recognized Canadian post-secondary institution, enrolled for the full internship
* Proficiency in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, CATIA or similar
* Working knowledge of CFD; STAR-CCM+ is an asset
* Familiarity with manufacturing processes, thermoplastics and composites
* Clear technical writing in English; French or Spanish is an asset
* Able to travel to the GTA for occasional on-site work

**Nice to have**  
Design team experience (Formula SAE, Baja, aero/rocketry), startup or low-volume manufacturing experience, or knowledge of SmartWay or CARB.

**Eligibility**  
This internship is funded through ECO Canada’s Student Work Placement Program, which requires applicants to be Canadian citizens or permanent residents currently enrolled at a recognized Canadian post-secondary institution.

**How to apply**  
Apply through LinkedIn, or send your resume, a short cover note and, if you have one, a portfolio (CAD or CFD work, design team projects) to mauricio.vargas@ecoeolictopsystem.com with the subject line “EETS Aero Intern – [Your Name]”.

EETS welcomes applications from women, Indigenous youth, racialized youth and youth living with disabilities.

Pay: Up to $19.70 per hour

Expected hours: 35.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Greater Toronto Area, ON

We specialize in innovative switched reluctance motor solutions, aiming to revolutionize energy systems for a cleaner, more efficient future. Join our dynamic team to be part of driving meaningful change towards sustainability in transportation and energy.

We are looking for a dynamic, knowledgeable, and highly **hands-on** co-op student to join our team and play a critical role in building our technology. The candidate will focus on the assembly, integration, and testing of our cutting-edge electric motors and electric vehicle systems. This role is ideal for someone who loves building, tinkering, and bringing new designs to life. You will be a key member of our manufacturing and engineering teams, working directly on prototype and production hardware.

You will get an opportunity to have a significant impact on our operations as we scale up. We expect you to be a dynamic team player who is meticulous, safety-conscious, and curious about how things are built.

Join our team at Enedym as an Assembly Technician Co-op and get diverse, hands-on experience building the future of electric propulsion. This role will focus on the **precision assembly of prototype and production electric motors**, building and integrating custom wire harnesses, supporting system-level testing, and assisting with our in-house electric vehicle conversion projects.

If you have a strong mechanical aptitude, love working with your hands, and enjoy collaborating in a team to build clean energy technologies, we invite you to apply and be part of our growth at Enedym.

* Perform **precision mechanical assembly** of switched reluctance motors and their sub-assemblies, following engineering instructions and drawings.
* Provide direct **hands-on support for electric vehicle conversions**, including system layout, mounting of motors and controllers, and integrating Enedym’s components.
* Build, route, and install **custom wire harnesses** and high-voltage/low-voltage cabling systems.
* Assist technicians and engineers in setting up and operating test equipment for motor and vehicle validation.
* Support the fabrication of brackets, fixtures, and mounting hardware using common workshop tools.
* Perform quality inspections on components, sub-assemblies, and final products to ensure they meet specifications.
* Work with the engineering team to identify and document assembly challenges, suggesting improvements for manufacturability.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and organized workshop environment, strictly adhering to all safety protocols (including high-voltage safety).
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives on the shop floor.
* Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot and solve build or integration problems as they arise.

### **Requirements**

* Currently enrolled in a Mechanical, Mechatronics, Automotive, Electromechanical, or skilled trades (e.g., Millwright, Automotive Technician) post-secondary program.
* **Strong mechanical aptitude** and excellent **hands-on skills** with a variety of hand tools, power tools (drills, grinders, etc.), and workshop equipment.
* A passion for building, assembling, or repairing complex systems (e.g., automotive work, robotics, machine assembly, personal projects).
* Ability to **read and interpret mechanical drawings** and electrical wiring diagrams.
* Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality work.
* Experience with **wire harness assembly**, connector crimping, and soldering is a strong asset.
* Understanding of and commitment to a **safety-first culture**, especially when working with high-voltage systems and rotating machinery.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technicians and engineers.
* A proactive, "can-do" attitude and a strong desire to learn.
